_doc: Task-level context for the OWAS/RULA/REBA modifiers that a single frame cannot show, keyed by the dataset's process label. static_or_repeated: whether a posture seen in one frame is taken as held or repeated (RULA muscle use, REBA activity); false, as in the expert's scoring. Per task: load_kg (typical handled load; unlisted tasks get 0 kg) and load_repeated (load handled repeatedly, RULA force/load score only). status: literature, provisional, or expert (the expert's task-level judgement, fixed before the held-out images are scored). Values never come from per-image expert scores.
